Container.Name: Noterat
Container.Overview: Noterat: notes, a journal, voice memos, lists, a budget, a calendar, recipes and a receipt and document scanner, for you and the people you choose to share with. Live when you're online, and the Android app keeps working offline. Everything lives in one folder (appdata). Lists, notes (Markdown), voice memos and a journal so far, shared live and working offline in the app, with search across all of it; voice memos and journal clips become text with the optional Noterat worker on an Nvidia GPU. The other sections come phase by phase.

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: Port of the website and the API the app uses. Put your reverse proxy (SWAG, Nginx Proxy Manager...) in front of it with HTTPS and WebSockets allowed (the live sync is a WebSocket at /sync), so phones can reach it from anywhere and share links work.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: The database and everything people add. Back this up (the Appdata Backup plugin does).

Config.Name: Public URL
Config.Description: The address people use, e.g. https://noterat.example.com. Used for share links.

Config.Name: Worker token
Config.Description: Optional: turns on speech to text for voice memos. A long random string (e.g. from openssl rand -hex 32), the same one the Noterat worker container gets. Without it, memos are recorded and played but not transcribed.

Config.Name: Visitor address header
Config.Description: Optional, behind a reverse proxy: the header it puts the visitor's address in (SWAG and Nginx Proxy Manager: x-real-ip; Cloudflare Tunnel: cf-connecting-ip), so password guessing is slowed down per visitor. Only set it when Noterat can't be reached except through that proxy.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User id Noterat runs as (99 = nobody on Unraid).

Config.Name: UMASK
Config.Description: File permission mask for files Noterat creates.
